name: dsi-studio-trk-ana
summary: Computes tract shape and size measures (length, span, volume, diameter, surface area, curl, elongation, irregularity) from a DSI Studio tinytrack file with DSI Studio and outputs a TSV table.
description: Runs dsi_studio --action=ana --export=stat on the tract file and stores the statistics as tractmeasure.tsv. Use it to quantify tract shape after tractography or bundle recognition in DSI Studio.

inputs.description: Tract file in DSI Studio tinytrack (.tt.gz) format.

citations.text: Yeh FC. Shape analysis of the human association pathways. NeuroImage 223:117329 (2020).

failure_modes.message: ERROR: Source or tract file does not exist. Check paths in config.json.
ERROR: Output file not generated. Check DSI Studio logs.
failure_modes.fix: Check the DSI Studio log for errors reading the tract file.
